name: Birmingham swung techno
desc: Surgeon/Regis-school swung techno kit: hard 909 four with the shuffle coming from elongation triplets ([hh@2 hh]) instead of the banned swing calls, a driving accented ride pushing the bar forward, and a dry rim answering off the 3. Meaner and more propulsive than the warehouse kit's rave stomp; the ride is the engine.
